title: Chapter 219 Four Development Directions
content:
Chapter 219 Four Development Directions

The Zerg occupied the territory of the ghouls in the underground world. The Zerg puppies cooperated with the Zerg host to carefully explore the entire territory and eliminate all hidden dangers.

The edge of the Zerg underground world territory is a wilderness area with a very peculiar environment, where many unknown creatures appear.

The Zerg base cannot cover such a large territory for the time being. The border areas between these territories and the wilderness area are first garrisoned by Zerg puppies to cooperate with the patrol of the Zerg host to ensure the safety of the territory.

The two underground passages that Wu Qing was most concerned about were dug by Zerg worker bees. There were traces of passages inside, but these traces disappeared after not digging deep.

Wu Qing guessed that these two underground passages were a special space transmission channel, which has now been destroyed.

To be honest, I have been using Yeguo Reading to read books and follow the updates recently. It can switch sources and has many reading tones. It can be used on Android and Apple.

Wu Qing was a little disappointed that he did not find the passages leading to the territories of other underground world races, but he also made unexpected discoveries.

The Zerg worker bees discovered that the Zerg underground world's territory is almost a mixed mine of high-quality metals and energy. Any random digging can produce a large amount of energy resources, which is many times more efficient than underground mining in the outside world.

Wu Qing has always been unwilling to use Zerg worker bees to mine resources, but he has not found a suitable mine and the efficiency of resource mining is too low.

After the Queen's calculation, it is very uneconomical to invest too many resources to increase the number of worker bees and mine resources in the limited territory of the Zerg with the mining efficiency of the outside world. The return on investment is too low.

Therefore, the resources mined by the Zerg worker bees only account for a small part of the system's energy resources. It is only a stable basic resource supplement, not the main source of system energy resources.

Now that the Zerg has such a large area of high-quality mines in the underground world, there is no need to worry about energy resources in the future.

With sufficient energy resource support, the number of Zerg puppies can be increased without limit, so that the Zerg's numerical advantage can be truly brought into play.

With a sufficient number of Zerg puppies, the Zerg can control more territory.

The population of the Zerg territory in the aboveground world is developed to ensure the stability of the source of system gas resources.

The Zerg territory in the underground world mines resources to ensure sufficient supply of energy resources in the system.

With the stable supply of resources from these two territories, the Zerg can maintain a normal development speed even when the Zerg army has no war to fight.

The efficiency of the Zerg is high. Once there is a plan, it will be executed immediately without any delay.

A large number of Zerg worker bees hatched and entered the Zerg underground world territory. They conducted a comprehensive survey of the entire territory and found the areas with the highest mining efficiency.

Since mining is to be carried out, the best minerals must be mined.

One by one, Zerg nests were built in the areas selected by the Zerg worker bees, and a large number of Zerg worker bees kept coming to mine resources.

As the Zerg worker bees were busy, the energy resources of the system began to grow rapidly.

With the energy resources mined in the Zerg underground world territory, Wu Qing no longer had to worry about energy resources. The number of Zerg puppies could finally be described as "sea".

There are not enough Zerg puppies in the Zerg's ground world territory. Wu Qing plans to meet the needs of the ground world territory first, and then use a large number of Zerg puppies to continue exploring the wilderness area of the underground world.

...

The Zerg eliminated the ghouls in the underground world, and all the enemies around the Zerg, except for the weird ones that cannot be touched, were eliminated.

The Zerg, a fighting race, cannot do without enemies!

Wu Qing wants to find some suitable enemies for the Zerg, so that the Zerg army can continue to fight!

Wu Qing sorted it out and found that there are four directions that can be used as breakthroughs. He needs to carefully consider the next action plan of the Zerg.

The first is the main battlefield of the camp war recommended by the Goblin Chamber of Commerce. This will be the main battlefield and development direction of the Zerg for some time in the future.

Because Wu Qing claimed that the battlefield sacrifice of the Zerg army is related to the number of Zerg energy coins, the Goblin Chamber of Commerce is very concerned about supporting the Zerg to participate in the war.

Only by fighting more wars can the Zerg provide enough Zerg energy coins for the Goblins.

This is the binding of the interests of the two tribes, the most reliable relationship. There is almost no suspense in the opening of this battlefield. Wu Qing put the main development direction of the Zerg in the future here.

The second is the main battlefield of the camp war in charge of the Naga tribe. There is a space teleportation array connecting the two tribes, and there is still a lot of room for operation in the future.

But Naga can not represent the entire Naga tribe. The future relationship between the Zerg and the Naga tribe is not a certainty, so this development direction has certain variables and can be regarded as a secondary development direction.

If there is a chance, Wu Qing will fully support Naga in this direction and enhance Naga's status in the Naga tribe.

The third is the underground world. There are too many unknown factors in the underground world, and it is impossible to predict the subsequent development. It can only continue to explore the outside world on the basis of consolidating the existing territory.

When the Zerg has enough Zerg puppies, Wu Qing will organize the Zerg puppies to enter the wilderness area of the underground world to find other underground world races.

The fourth is in the north of the special territory controlled by the Zerg in the ground world, the real exit of the Zerg to this world.

Adjacent to the Zerg territory is an area called the Southern Free Land. The so-called free land means that this place does not belong to the sphere of influence of any major tribe.

In the native camp of this world, there are many free lands. Free lands named after directions such as "South" and "North" must be giants among them.

Because the free land is not the sphere of influence of the big clans, there are all kinds of people in it, and various forces are numerous and very chaotic.

Among them, there are representatives of various big clans and big forces, various strong clans that are not enough to meet the standards of big clans, ordinary local races, various independent territories, various free cities, large and small forces, countless refugees seeking survival, and countless dark forces.

The southern free land, which is adjacent to the north of the Zerg territory, is one of the few free lands in this world. Its vast area and numerous forces are ranked in the top few.

The place where the Zerg territory is located is an inconspicuous little corner of the southern free land. It is a small stronghold of the Naga and Tengu tribes in the free land. Because it is surrounded by endless mountains, it is a taboo place that other forces avoid.

Except for businessmen like Gong Zhe, few people will take the initiative to enter the forbidden area.

In the recent camp wars, the overall situation of the local camp's continuous retreat has also affected the situation in the Southern Free Land, allowing the evil god camp to advance the front line to the location of the Zerg territory.

Going out of the Zerg territory, the left is the Southern Free Land, and the right is the territory of the Zerg's old friend, the Demon Clan.

This is the general situation around the Zerg territory. This is the information provided by Naga, and Wu Qing also got confirmation from Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

In the Southern Free Land, the Zerg can enter and exit freely without the need for a space transmission channel, and is not restricted by others.

If the Zerg wants to build a space transmission channel by itself, it needs to wait until the mother nest evolves again and the Zerg building of the pupa channel comes out.

For the time being, only the space transmission channels of the Goblins and Nagas can be used. They are restricted by others and can only be manipulated by others, and it is difficult to be independent.

In addition, the pattern of the Southern Free Land not being dominated by one party is also what Wu Qing likes.

Therefore, the Southern Free Land is the most controllable development direction for the Zerg.

As long as the Zerg drives back the evil god camp in this direction, the territory recovered by the Zerg will naturally become the territory of the Zerg.

Before that, the Zerg must first enter the Southern Free Land and find a point of entry to participate in the camp war, otherwise it is easy to cause problems if they rush out and fight randomly.

In the outside world, there is no limit to the upper limit of strength. The current strength of the Zerg is far behind that of the real big tribes, and it needs to continue to accumulate.

There are three conditions in the four development directions that are not yet met. Only entering the Southern Free Land is feasible.

…

The territories of the Naga and Tengu tribes were quickly recovered by the Zerg. The Sky Silkworm Knights who were originally responsible for promoting the Sky Silkworm Nine Transformations to the outside world no longer need to promote it in the Zerg territory.

They canceled the original plan and prepared to enter the Southern Free Land directly.

There is a large uninhabited area between the Zerg territory and the Southern Free Land. The original Naga and Tengu tribes did not develop in this direction, and people from the Free Land outside rarely entered this area.

In the eyes of outsiders, entering here is equivalent to entering the Endless Mountains, which is very risky. The Naga and Tengu tribes dared to send people to develop their territories because of the intelligence within the tribe.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce and some forces that know the inside story will regularly send caravans or station personnel to pay attention to the situation of the two tribes and the news of unknown opportunities.

In general, people from the outside world rarely enter this area of the Zerg territory.

With the isolation of this uninhabited area, the Zerg territory is like a paradise, undisturbed by the outside world, and very peaceful.

The situation that the Zerg puppy saw at the border of the adjacent Demon Tribe is the same. There is a large uninhabited area that separates the Zerg from the Demon Tribe.

Wu Qing sent out a transport host to pick up a hundred Silkworm Knights and sent them to the edge of the free land.

After this period of activity, the Silkworms on the one hundred Silkworm Knights consumed a lot. After they were replenished on the transport host, all of them evolved and upgraded.

After the evolution, one hundred Silkworm Knights, led by a four-star Knight, included ten three-star team leaders and eighty-nine two-star members.

Their Zerg warhorses were synchronously evolved and upgraded to the same heavy-level strength as the Knights.

The reason why the Silkworm Knights had to upgrade their strength was that the external environment was completely different from the Tengu and Naga cities where they originally walked, and it was much darker and crueler.

The proportion of strong people was not what was seen in the restricted area of the Zerg territory, and people with star-level strength were very common.
